verdict.rationale: The California Franchise Tax Board is a government tax-filing and payment service, not an AI agent or host application, so letting users plug in MCP servers for the product to call is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains only edge-denial probes (HTTP 403 at robots.txt and the webapp host) and shows no AI-client capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
